met_analysis:
The Low Pressure Area over Northwest Bay of Bengal & neighbourhood now lies over Northwest-Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh coasts at 0530 hrs IST of today, the 11 September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 7.6 km above mean sea level tilting southwestwards with height.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northwest Uttar Pradesh now lies over southwest Uttar Pradesh and adjoining north Madhya Pradesh between 1.5 & 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The trough now runs from north Rajasthan to cyclonic circulation associated with the Low Pressure Area over Northwest-Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh coasts across Madhya Pradesh & Chhattisgarh and extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level now passes through Sri Ganganagar, Guna, Jabalpur, Bilaspur to the centre of Low Pressure Area over Northwest-Westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh coasts and thence east southeastwards to Eastcentral Bay of Bengal.
The trough from South Interior Karnataka to Gulf of Mannar across Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south Gujarat & neighbourhood between 4.5 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over north Pakistan and adjoining Jammu at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
